comments.content:
Icons should be named in a consistent manner, instead of the current
hodge-podge manner. The icon breakout needs to be updated as well to form a
usable hierarchy.

For example, instead of camera and camera1 => camera, camera-disabled
Instead of computer, broken, and c_unpowered => computer, computer-broken,
computer-disabled

regpipes.dmi already uses a similar naming scheme with -b for broken and -f for
beneath floor (though invisible)
